pages.text: Create Nuclear adds uranium, thorium, a multiblock reactor and radiation. The reactor outputs ordinary rotation through a shaft, so it plugs into any Create network. It is also the pack's source of lead.

pages.title: Uranium chain
pages.text: Crush raw uranium to powder, mix it into liquid, compact that to Yellowcake. Thorium follows a similar route. Check JEI.

pages.title: Enriching Campfire
pages.text: Its green Enriching Fire, blown through by a fan, turns Yellowcake into Enriched Yellowcake. Make it from Enriched Soul Soil.

pages.title: Fuel rods
pages.text: Enriched Yellowcake pressed in a Mechanical Crafter makes Uranium Rods (fuel). Graphite Rods, from graphene and steel, are the cooling rods.

Reactor build: Reactor Casing (a Brass Casing plus steel) forms a T1, T2 or T3 tower following the pattern in Ponder. Place the Controller, then a Rod Input, Fluid Input, Output and an optional Alarm in casing spots.

pages.title: Reactor Controller
pages.text: Right-click it with a filled Reactor Blueprint to start. You need fuel and cooling rods, plus water or liquid nitrogen in the Fluid Input.

Too hot with too little cooling and the reactor melts down and explodes. Two Rod Inputs are needed: one for heating rods, one for cooling. Put an Alarm nearby. Drive a shaft off the Reactor Output for rotation.

pages.title: Radiation
pages.text: Radiation hurts, and irradiated mobs exist. Anti Radiation armor protects. It can be dyed with cloth.

Steel here is made by mixing coal dust and an iron ingot in a heated mixer, and it gives TFMG steel. The reactor accepts any steel (see $(l:materials/shared_metals)Shared Metals$(/l)). Create Nuclear's lead is the pack's only lead. Rotation to FE: $(l:industry/power_compared)Rotation vs Electricity$(/l).
